top_signals.title: Correspondence: Open letters between HM Treasury and Bank of England, September 2026
top_signals.summary: CPI inflation was 3.1% in August 2026, prompting an open letter from the Governor of the Bank of England to the Chancellor on 17 September 2026. The Chancellor replied to the Governor on 17 September 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Steady as Tech Outperforms and Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks were the standout performers as US equity futures steadied, making for a calmer end to a turbulent week. Oil fell for a third straight day.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The QT endgame at the BoE
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
